conditions.input: 16 COCO val2017 JPEG images, batch 1, 640 x 640
conditions.scope: JPEG decode, letterbox, forward including host/device transfers, and postprocessing
conditions.memory: Host process RSS sampled at request boundaries. PyTorch CUDA allocator peaks are separate from process VRAM. ORT GPU VRAM peak was not measured.
conditions.parity: One-to-one matching by class and IoU >= 0.50 on the same 16 JPEG images
limitations: Shared CPU resources may affect timing.
ONNX CUDA uses FP32 with TF32 allowed.
